hub.headline: Three practices. One firm.
hub.lead: Business Solutions for a Digital World. B2B partnerships for firms entering the US, AI solutions development, and digital presence.

choose.heading: Choose the practice that fits your problem.
choose.intro: Three practices, each for a different kind of buyer. Start with the one that matches what you need.

fit.heading: Separate practices, one way of working.
paragraphs: Each practice stands on its own. You can start with one and add another later.
They share the same way of working: plain advice and clear steps from the first call to the handover.

Some problems cross the lines. A firm entering the US may also need a website that speaks to American buyers. A team building an application may need clear content to explain it. Tell us about both and we will say how to sequence them.

cta.heading: Not sure which practice fits?
cta.text: Book a consultation and tell us what you are trying to do. We will say, candidly, which practice can help and where to begin.

process.heading: From first call to handover.
process.intro: A clear, sequenced engagement. No theory without traction.

steps.name: Understand
steps.text: We start with your goals, your constraints and what you have already tried.

steps.name: Plan
steps.text: We agree what will be done, in what order, and what a good result looks like.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.text: We do the work and keep you informed as it happens.

steps.name: Hand over
steps.text: We hand over what we built and agree what happens next.

pillars.name: B2B Partnerships
pillars.tagline: Enter new markets through the right partners.
pillars.summary: Market entry research, channel strategy and enablement, partner introductions and regional expansion for international companies entering the United States.
pillars.hub_line: For international firms entering the US. Channel strategy and partner introductions for companies new to the American market.
pillars.lead: We guide international companies into the United States through disciplined channel activity, turning ambition into distribution, partners and revenue.
pillars.do_heading: A focused practice for crossing the border.
pillars.intro: Four disciplines, one objective: a commercial foothold in North America built on real channel relationships.

who.heading: Companies ready to sell in the United States.
who.intro: Our work suits international firms with a product and a decision to make about North America.

items.title: Firms deciding whether to enter
items.text: You want an honest read on whether, where and how to enter before you commit.

items.title: Firms that need a route to market
items.text: You need distributors, resellers or agents, and the terms and training that make them sell.

items.title: Firms ready to grow beyond the US
items.text: Your US engine is running and Canada and Latin America are next.

cta.heading: Not sure where to begin?
cta.text: Most engagements start with a market read. Book a consultation and we will tell you, candidly, where the opening is.

services.name: US Market Entry Research
services.summary: Sizing, segmentation and competitive intelligence that tells you where to play - and where not to - before you spend a dollar on the ground.

detail.text: Before commitment comes clarity. We map the real shape of US demand for your category - where it concentrates, who already owns it, and the regulatory and pricing realities you'll meet on arrival. You get an honest read on whether, where and how to enter.

faq.q: What does US market entry research cover?
faq.a: It maps US demand for your category: where it concentrates, who already owns it, and the regulatory and pricing realities you will meet on arrival. It covers market sizing and segmentation, the competitive and pricing landscape, a regulatory and compliance scan, and demand and buyer-persona mapping.

faq.q: What do I get at the end?
faq.a: An honest read on whether, where and how to enter the US, with a beachhead market recommendation and a go or no-go entry thesis.

faq.q: When should a company do this?
faq.a: Before you spend money on the ground. It suits international firms that want an honest read on whether, where and how to enter before they commit.

services.name: Channel Strategy & Enablement
services.summary: Designing the route to market - distributors, resellers, agents - and equipping them with the tools, terms and training to actually sell.

detail.text: The route to market is the strategy. We design the channel architecture suited to your product and margins - distributors, resellers, agents or hybrid - then build the commercial terms, materials and training that turn a partner signature into actual sales.

faq.q: Should I use distributors, resellers or agents in the US?
faq.a: It depends on your product and margins. We design the channel architecture that suits them: distributors, resellers, agents or a hybrid. Our post {post} walks through when each one fits.

faq.q: What does channel enablement include?
faq.a: The commercial terms, materials and training that turn a partner signature into sales: partner economics and incentives, a sales enablement toolkit, an onboarding and training program, and the pricing and margin structure.

faq.q: How do you measure whether the channel is working?
faq.a: We build a performance and KPI framework into the channel design.

services.name: B2B Partner Introductions
services.summary: Warm, qualified introductions to the buyers, channel partners and decision-makers who move your category in the United States.

detail.text: Relationships open the US market - and we have them. We make warm, qualified introductions to the buyers, channel partners and decision-makers who actually move your category, then support the first conversations so they convert into agreements.

faq.q: Who do you introduce us to?
faq.a: The buyers, channel partners and decision-makers who move your category in the United States, drawn from a vetted long-list of target partners.

faq.q: Are these cold introductions?
faq.a: No. They are warm introductions, made personally, through relationships we already hold.

faq.q: What happens after the introduction?
faq.a: We prepare for and support the first meetings, help negotiate deals and terms, and hand the relationship over to your team.

services.name: Regional Expansion · Canada & LATAM
services.summary: Extending the playbook north and south - adapting channel models for Canada and Latin America once the US engine is running.

detail.text: Once the US engine runs, the continent opens up. We extend your proven playbook into Canada and Latin America - adapting channel models, partner profiles and commercial terms to each market's language, regulation and buying culture.

faq.q: When should we expand into Canada or Latin America?
faq.a: Once your US channel is running. We then extend the playbook that worked in the US north and south.

faq.q: What changes from one market to the next?
faq.a: Channel models, partner profiles and commercial terms are adapted to each market's language, regulation and buying culture.

faq.q: What does the work include?
faq.a: Canada market and channel entry, prioritizing and sequencing Latin American markets, local partner sourcing, cross-border commercial terms, regulatory and tax navigation, and governance across markets.

process.intro: A clear, sequenced engagement. No open-ended retainers, no theory without traction.

final.name: Hand over
final.text: Success is your team running it without us. We transfer what we built and step back.

pillars.name: AI Solutions Development
pillars.tagline: AI built around the problem in front of you.
pillars.summary: We solve business problems with AI: custom applications, workflow automation and operational efficiency.
pillars.hub_line: For teams that need AI built. Custom applications, workflow automation and operational efficiency.
pillars.lead: We solve business problems with AI: custom applications, workflow automation and operational efficiency.
pillars.do_heading: Three ways we put AI to work.
pillars.intro: We start with the problem, not the technology. Sometimes the answer is AI. Sometimes a simpler fix is better. We tell you which.

who.heading: Teams with a real problem to solve.
who.intro: You do not need to know what the technology should be. You need to know where the work is slow, repetitive or stuck.

items.title: Teams buried in manual work
items.text: People re-keying data, chasing approvals or moving files by hand, and wanting that time back.

items.title: Businesses the standard tools do not fit
items.text: You have tried off-the-shelf software and the way you work does not fit it.

items.title: Leaders who want to know where the time goes
items.text: You suspect there are gaps in how the operation runs and want someone to find them and fix the biggest ones.

cta.heading: Tell us what is slowing you down.
cta.text: A short, candid conversation about the work you want off your plate.

services.name: Custom Applications
services.summary: Applications built around how your business works.

detail.text: When off-the-shelf software does not fit the way you work, we build an application that does. We start with the problem and the people who will use it, then design, build and hand over a working tool, using AI where it helps and simpler software where it does not.

faq.q: When does a business need a custom application?
faq.a: When off-the-shelf software does not fit the way you work.

faq.q: Do you always use AI?
faq.a: No. We start with the problem and the people who will use the tool, and use AI where it helps and simpler software where it does not.

faq.q: How is the application built?
faq.a: In stages. We define the problem and requirements, map the users and workflow, design and plan the build, build it in stages, test it with your team, then hand it over with documentation.

services.name: Workflow Automation
services.summary: Repetitive, manual steps handed to automation, so people spend their time on the work that needs judgment.

detail.text: Re-keying data, chasing approvals and moving files by hand take hours your team could spend on work that needs judgment. We map the steps, find the ones a machine can do reliably, and automate them, keeping a person in the loop wherever a decision needs one.
deliverables: Automated workflows, tested end to end

faq.q: Which tasks should we automate first?
faq.a: Steps a machine can do reliably, like re-keying data, chasing approvals and moving files by hand. Our post {post} covers how to pick the first one.

faq.q: Will automation replace people's decisions?
faq.a: No. We keep a person in the loop wherever a decision needs one, with human review and exception handling built in.

faq.q: What do we get?
faq.a: A map of your current workflow, a shortlist of what to automate, the tools and integrations chosen, automated workflows tested end to end, and training and a runbook for your team.

services.name: Operational Efficiency
services.summary: A close look at where time and effort are lost in your operations, and practical fixes for the biggest gaps.

detail.text: We take a close look at how your operation runs: where time goes, where work waits and where effort is repeated. You get a clear picture of the biggest gaps and a practical plan to close them, whether the fix is AI, automation or a change in process.

faq.q: What is an operational efficiency review?
faq.a: A close look at how your operation runs: where time goes, where work waits and where effort is repeated.

faq.q: What do we get from it?
faq.a: A clear picture of the biggest gaps, a prioritized list of fixes, an implementation roadmap and measures to track progress.

faq.q: Is the fix always AI?
faq.a: No. It may be AI, automation or a change in process, whichever closes the gap.

pillars.name: Digital Presence
pillars.tagline: Be found, be clear, be connected online.
pillars.summary: Websites, digital marketing, and community and content, so your business is seen, understood and connected online.
pillars.hub_line: For businesses building their presence online. Websites, digital marketing, and community and content.
pillars.lead: Websites, digital marketing, and community and content, so your business is seen, understood and connected online.
pillars.do_heading: Three parts of a digital presence.
pillars.intro: Websites give your brand a presence. Digital marketing takes it online. Community and content connect it with your audience.

who.heading: Businesses building their presence online.
who.intro: Whether you are starting out or already online, we begin with what your business needs.

items.title: Businesses without a website
items.text: You need a website that says who you are and what you do.

items.title: Businesses with a site and no audience
items.text: The website is there, but the right people are not finding it.

items.title: Businesses with an audience to look after
items.text: You want content and community work that connects your brand with its audience.

cta.heading: Let us look at your presence together.
cta.text: A short, candid conversation about how your business shows up online today and what to fix first.

services.name: Websites
services.summary: Brand presence: a website that says who you are and what you do.

detail.text: Your website is often the first place a buyer meets your business. We plan, write and build a site that says clearly who you are, what you do and how to reach you, built to work for every visitor and to be easy for you to keep up to date.

faq.q: What goes into a website you build?
faq.a: A site structure and page plan, messaging and page copy, visual design in your brand, a responsive and accessible build, and the search essentials: titles, descriptions and a sitemap.

faq.q: Will we be able to update it ourselves?
faq.a: Yes. We build it to be easy for you to keep up to date, and hand it over at launch.

faq.q: Who is it for?
faq.a: Businesses that need a website that says who they are and what they do, whether they are starting out or already online.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.summary: Brand online: digital marketing that puts your brand in front of the right people.

detail.text: A website only works when the right people find it. We work out who you want to reach and where they spend their time online, then plan and run the channels that put your brand in front of them, keeping what works and dropping what does not.

faq.q: Our website is live but nobody finds it. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. A website only works when the right people find it. We work out who you want to reach and where they spend their time online, then plan and run the channels that put your brand in front of them.

faq.q: Which channels do you work with?
faq.a: Search, social media, and email and newsletters, planned and launched as campaigns.

faq.q: How do you know what is working?
faq.a: We report on what is working, keep it, and drop what does not.

services.name: Community & Content
services.summary: Brand connect: content and community that connect your brand with its audience.

detail.text: Attention is earned by being useful. We help you publish content your audience wants and build a community around it, so people come back, talk back and remember who you are.

faq.q: What kind of content do you produce?
faq.a: Articles, posts and newsletters, plus planning for podcasts and video, built on a content strategy and editorial themes.

faq.q: Why build a community around a brand?
faq.a: Attention is earned by being useful. Content your audience wants, with a community around it, brings people back, gets them talking back and helps them remember who you are.

faq.q: How often do you publish?
faq.a: We set a publishing calendar and rhythm with you, and review audience feedback and engagement along the way.
